name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month of days to pick from, with ranges.
use: Picking a day or a range of days in the page, with the week in view. It is an ARIA grid of buttons: the stylesheet draws every state, and the script supplies the dates, the month buttons and the keys. It has no surface of its own: put it in a card, or in a popover to make a date picker.

instead.when: A plain date is all the form needs, or the reader is on a phone: a native date input opens the picker of the device
The value is a time, picked by touch

keyboard.action: Move focus to the day before or the day after; the other way around from right to left
Move focus to the same weekday of the week before or after
Move focus to the first or the last day of the week
Show the month before or after and move focus to the same day in it, or to its last day when it is shorter
Show the same month of the year before or after and move focus to the same day in it
Choose the day that has focus; the day is a button, so the browser turns the key into its click
Enters the grid at the chosen day, or at today, or at the first day of a month that holds neither; the grid is one tab stop

classes.name: calendar
classes.description: The month: a header over a grid of days

classes.name: calendar-header
classes.description: The row over the grid: a button to the month before, the title, a button to the month after

classes.name: calendar-title
classes.description: The name of the month, centered between the two buttons; give it aria-live="polite" so a change of month is announced

classes.name: calendar-grid
classes.description: The seven-column grid, with role="grid" and labelled by the title

classes.name: calendar-week
classes.description: A row on the grid's columns, with role="row": the weekday names, or a week of days

classes.name: calendar-weekday
classes.description: A column heading with role="columnheader"; give it the full name of the day as aria-label

classes.name: calendar-day
classes.description: A day, on a button with role="gridcell". One day is in the tab order; the others have tabindex="-1". Its value is its date as YYYY-MM-DD: the behavior writes it, and reads it from days that something else wrote

classes.name: calendar-day-outside
classes.description: A day of the month before or after, shown in muted ink to complete a week

classes.name: calendar-day-range-start
classes.description: The first day of a range: an ink day on the half of the band that faces the range. With calendar-day-range-end on the same day, a range of one day

classes.name: calendar-day-range
classes.description: A day between the ends of a range: a chip-toned band from cell to cell, rounded where a week ends

classes.name: calendar-day-range-end
classes.description: The last day of a range: an ink day on the half of the band that faces the range

states.name: today
states.description: A dot under the number, kept when the day is chosen

states.name: chosen
states.description: Fills with ink, the way a checked checkbox does. Every day of a range carries it. aria-pressed="true" draws the same

properties.name: --calendar-cell
properties.description: Width and height of a day; 2.75rem on touch screens
